NginxProxyManager/nginx-proxy-manager.summary_en: A Docker image with a web UI for managing Nginx reverse proxies, forwarding sites and obtaining free SSL certificates without knowing Nginx configuration.

swc-project/swc.summary: 用 Rust 编写的极速 TypeScript / JavaScript 编译器，可作 Babel 替代，被 Next.js 等框架内置使用。
swc-project/swc.summary_en: An extremely fast TypeScript and JavaScript compiler written in Rust that can replace Babel and is built into frameworks such as Next.js.

zenorocha/clipboard.js.summary: 仅 3KB 的现代复制到剪贴板库，无需 Flash，用简单的 HTML 属性或 API 即可使用。
zenorocha/clipboard.js.summary_en: A 3KB modern copy-to-clipboard library with no Flash, usable through simple HTML attributes or an API.

xkcoding/spring-boot-demo.summary: 深入学习 Spring Boot 的实战项目，包含六十多个集成示例，涵盖监控、日志、缓存、消息队列、权限与第三方登录等。
xkcoding/spring-boot-demo.summary_en: A hands-on Spring Boot learning project with over sixty integration demos covering monitoring, logging, caching, message queues, authorization, and third-party login.

rustfs/rustfs.summary: 用 Rust 写的高性能分布式对象存储，兼容 S3，支持与 MinIO、Ceph 等 S3 兼容平台迁移和并存。
rustfs/rustfs.summary_en: A high-performance distributed object store written in Rust, S3-compatible, supporting migration from and coexistence with MinIO, Ceph, and other S3-compatible platforms.

k3s-io/k3s.summary: 轻量级 Kubernetes 发行版，单个不到 100MB 的二进制，内存占用减半，适用于边缘、IoT 和 CI 场景。
k3s-io/k3s.summary_en: A lightweight Kubernetes distribution shipped as a single binary under 100 MB with roughly half the memory footprint, suited to edge, IoT, and CI.

atlassian/react-beautiful-dnd.summary: 面向 React 列表的美观、无障碍拖拽库，已归档并在 npm 上弃用，Atlassian 推荐迁移到新方案。
atlassian/react-beautiful-dnd.summary_en: A beautiful, accessible drag-and-drop library for React lists, now archived and deprecated on npm, with Atlassian pointing to its newer replacement.

apache/kafka.summary: 分布式事件流平台，用于高吞吐的数据管道、流分析和数据集成，广泛用作消息队列与事件总线。
apache/kafka.summary_en: A distributed event streaming platform for high-throughput data pipelines, stream analytics, and data integration, widely used as a message queue and event bus.

motiondivision/motion.summary: 面向 JavaScript、React 和 Vue 的现代动画库（原 Framer Motion），声明式 API，支持手势、布局与滚动动画。
motiondivision/motion.summary_en: A modern animation library for JavaScript, React, and Vue (formerly Framer Motion) with a declarative API and support for gestures, layout, and scroll animations.

alibaba/easyexcel.summary: 阿里巴巴的 Java Excel 读写工具，逐行流式处理以避免大文件内存溢出；项目已发布维护公告，进入维护模式。
alibaba/easyexcel.summary_en: Alibaba's Java Excel reader and writer that processes rows in a streaming fashion to avoid out-of-memory errors on large files; the project has announced it is entering maintenance mode.

Blankj/AndroidUtilCode.summary: Android 开发常用工具类合集，覆盖 App、设备、网络、文件、图片、加密等，方便一行调用。
Blankj/AndroidUtilCode.summary_en: A collection of commonly needed Android utilities covering apps, devices, networking, files, images, and encryption, callable in a line.

vbenjs/vue-vben-admin.summary: 基于 Vue 3、Vite、TypeScript 与 Shadcn UI 的开源中后台模板，采用 Monorepo 结构，提供多套 UI 适配。
vbenjs/vue-vben-admin.summary_en: A free open-source admin template built on Vue 3, Vite, TypeScript, and Shadcn UI in a monorepo, with adapters for several UI libraries.

remix-run/remix.summary: Remix 3 的源码仓库，主打「全栈」的 Web 框架，基于 Web 标准构建，正在积极开发中。
remix-run/remix.summary_en: The source repository of Remix 3, a full-stack web framework built on web standards and under active development.

AFNetworking/AFNetworking.summary: iOS / macOS 经典网络库，基于 NSURLSession，2023 年起已弃用并归档，官方建议迁移到 Alamofire 等方案。
AFNetworking/AFNetworking.summary_en: The classic iOS and macOS networking library built on NSURLSession, deprecated and archived since 2023, with migration to alternatives such as Alamofire recommended.

zeromicro/go-zero.summary: 云原生 Go 微服务框架，内置限流、熔断、缓存、超时控制等工程实践，并带代码生成命令行工具。
zeromicro/go-zero.summary_en: A cloud-native Go microservice framework with built-in rate limiting, circuit breaking, caching, and timeout control, plus a code-generation CLI.

tokio-rs/tokio.summary: Rust 的异步运行时，提供 I/O、网络、调度和定时器，是 Rust 异步 Web 与网络服务的基础。
tokio-rs/tokio.summary_en: The asynchronous runtime for Rust, providing I/O, networking, scheduling, and timers, and the foundation for async web and network services in Rust.

certbot/certbot.summary: EFF 出品的 Let's Encrypt 证书申请工具，可自动获取证书并为服务器启用 HTTPS，也支持其他 ACME 机构。
certbot/certbot.summary_en: EFF's Let's Encrypt client that obtains certificates and can automatically enable HTTPS on a server, also working with other ACME authorities.

binarywang/WxJava.summary: 微信开发 Java SDK，覆盖微信支付、公众号、小程序、企业微信、视频号、开放平台等后端能力。
binarywang/WxJava.summary_en: A Java SDK for WeChat development, covering WeChat Pay, official accounts, mini-programs, WeCom, Channels, and the open platform on the back end.

surrealdb/surrealdb.summary: 可扩展的分布式文档图数据库，面向实时 Web 应用，用 Rust 编写，提供自有查询语言 SurrealQL，并内置权限与实时订阅。
surrealdb/surrealdb.summary_en: A scalable distributed document-graph database for real-time web apps, written in Rust, with its own SurrealQL query language, built-in permissions, and live subscriptions.

immutable-js/immutable-js.summary: JavaScript 的不可变持久化数据结构库，提供 List、Map、Set 等集合，通过结构共享提升效率。
immutable-js/immutable-js.summary_en: A library of immutable persistent data structures for JavaScript, offering List, Map, Set, and more with structural sharing for efficiency.

podman-container-tools/podman.summary: 无守护进程的容器与 Pod 管理工具，命令兼容 Docker，可以无 root 权限运行 OCI 容器。
podman-container-tools/podman.summary_en: A daemonless tool for managing OCI containers and pods with Docker-compatible commands, able to run containers without root.

gulpjs/gulp.summary: 基于流的前端自动化构建工具，用 JavaScript 代码定义任务，处理编译、压缩、监听等工作流。
gulpjs/gulp.summary_en: A stream-based front-end automation toolkit that defines tasks in JavaScript for compiling, minifying, watching, and other workflows.

yewstack/yew.summary: Rust / WebAssembly 前端框架，用类似 React 的组件与 JSX 风格宏构建客户端 Web 应用。
yewstack/yew.summary_en: A Rust and WebAssembly front-end framework for client-side web apps, using React-like components and JSX-style macros.

floating-ui/floating-ui.summary: 定位浮层元素（提示框、下拉、弹出层）的 JavaScript 库，前身为 Popper，提供 React、Vue 等绑定。
floating-ui/floating-ui.summary_en: A JavaScript library for positioning floating elements such as tooltips, dropdowns, and popovers, formerly Popper, with React and Vue bindings.

labstack/echo.summary: 高性能、极简的 Go Web 框架，提供路由、中间件、数据绑定和自动 TLS，基于标准库 net/http。
labstack/echo.summary_en: A high-performance, minimalist Go web framework with routing, middleware, data binding, and automatic TLS, built on the standard net/http.

lovell/sharp.summary: 基于 libvips 的高性能 Node.js 图片处理模块，快速缩放和转换 JPEG、PNG、WebP、AVIF 等格式。
lovell/sharp.summary_en: A high-performance Node.js image-processing module based on libvips that resizes and converts JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and more quickly.

ziadoz/awesome-php.summary: PHP 库、资源和工具的精选清单，按类别整理。
ziadoz/awesome-php.summary_en: A curated list of PHP libraries, resources, and tools organized by category.

pmndrs/react-three-fiber.summary: Three.js 的 React 渲染器，用声明式组件和 hooks 搭建 3D 场景，与 React 生态无缝配合。
pmndrs/react-three-fiber.summary_en: A React renderer for Three.js that builds 3D scenes with declarative components and hooks, integrating seamlessly with the React ecosystem.

cockroachdb/cockroach.summary: 云原生分布式 SQL 数据库，兼容 PostgreSQL 协议，强一致、高可用，支持水平扩展与数据放置控制。
cockroachdb/cockroach.summary_en: A cloud-native distributed SQL database compatible with the PostgreSQL wire protocol, strongly consistent and highly available, with horizontal scaling and data-placement control.

vercel/swr.summary: React 数据请求 hooks 库，采用「先返回缓存再重新验证」（stale-while-revalidate）策略，自动缓存、重试与聚焦刷新。
vercel/swr.summary_en: A React hooks library for data fetching using the stale-while-revalidate strategy, with automatic caching, retries, and revalidation on focus.

beego/beego.summary: Go 语言高性能 Web 框架，用于快速开发企业级应用，含 RESTful API、ORM、缓存、日志与任务模块。
beego/beego.summary_en: A high-performance Go web framework for rapid enterprise application development, including RESTful APIs, an ORM, caching, logging, and task modules.

honojs/hono.summary: 基于 Web 标准的小巧超快 Web 框架，可运行于 Cloudflare Workers、Deno、Bun、Node.js 等多种运行时。
honojs/hono.summary_en: A small, ultrafast web framework built on Web Standards that runs on Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, Node.js, and other runtimes.

google/material-design-lite.summary: Google 的 Material Design 组件库（纯 HTML / CSS / JS 实现），已停止开发，被 Material Components 取代。
google/material-design-lite.summary_en: Google's Material Design component library in plain HTML, CSS, and JS, no longer under development and superseded by Material Components.

dokku/dokku.summary: 基于 Docker 的迷你 Heroku，最小的自托管 PaaS，用 git push 部署应用并管理生命周期。
dokku/dokku.summary_en: A Docker-powered mini-Heroku, the smallest self-hosted PaaS, deploying apps via git push and managing their lifecycle.

kubernetes/minikube.summary: 在本地运行单节点 Kubernetes 集群的工具，方便开发和试验，支持多种驱动与插件。
kubernetes/minikube.summary_en: A tool for running a single-node Kubernetes cluster locally for development and experimentation, with many drivers and add-ons.

facebook/rocksdb.summary: Meta 开发的可嵌入持久化键值存储库，针对闪存和内存优化，是众多数据库和流处理系统的存储引擎。
facebook/rocksdb.summary_en: Meta's embeddable persistent key-value store optimized for flash and RAM, used as the storage engine of many databases and stream-processing systems.

filamentphp/filament.summary: 面向 Laravel 的 UI 框架，基于 Livewire，可快速搭建管理后台、表单、表格和应用界面。
filamentphp/filament.summary_en: A UI framework for Laravel built on Livewire, used to quickly build admin panels, forms, tables, and application interfaces.

airbnb/lottie-web.summary: Airbnb 的 Lottie 网页版，把 After Effects 通过 Bodymovin 导出的动画在网页里以 SVG / Canvas 渲染。
airbnb/lottie-web.summary_en: Airbnb's Lottie for the web, rendering After Effects animations exported via Bodymovin as SVG or Canvas in the browser.

hasura/graphql-engine.summary: 在数据库之上即时生成实时 GraphQL API 的引擎，支持细粒度权限控制和数据库事件触发 webhook。
hasura/graphql-engine.summary_en: An engine that instantly generates realtime GraphQL APIs on top of databases, with fine-grained access control and webhooks triggered by database events.

codex-team/editor.js.summary: 块状（block-style）富文本编辑器，输出干净的 JSON 数据，通过插件扩展块类型。
codex-team/editor.js.summary_en: A block-style rich-text editor that outputs clean JSON data and extends block types through plugins.

alpinejs/alpine.summary: 轻量的 JavaScript 框架，直接在 HTML 标记里用属性声明交互行为，语法类似 Vue，适合给服务端渲染页面添加交互。
alpinejs/alpine.summary_en: A lightweight JavaScript framework that declares behavior via attributes right in your markup, with Vue-like syntax, well suited to adding interactivity to server-rendered pages.

niklasvh/html2canvas.summary: 在浏览器里把网页元素渲染成 Canvas 截图的库，基于 DOM 和 CSS 信息重建而非真实截屏。
niklasvh/html2canvas.summary_en: A library that renders web page elements to a Canvas screenshot in the browser by rebuilding them from DOM and CSS rather than capturing the screen.

Trinea/android-open-project.summary: Android 开源项目分类汇总，按 UI、网络、数据库、工具等整理常用库。
Trinea/android-open-project.summary_en: A categorized roundup of Android open-source projects, organizing common libraries by UI, networking, databases, and tooling.

mantinedev/mantine.summary: 功能齐全的 React 组件库，提供上百个组件和 hooks，含表单、日期、通知等模块，样式基于 CSS Modules。
mantinedev/mantine.summary_en: A full-featured React component library with over a hundred components and hooks, including forms, dates, and notifications, styled with CSS Modules.

influxdata/influxdb.summary: 面向指标、事件与实时分析的开源时序数据库，本版本为 InfluxDB 3，基于 Rust 和 Apache Arrow。
influxdata/influxdb.summary_en: An open-source time-series database for metrics, events, and real-time analytics; this version is InfluxDB 3, built on Rust and Apache Arrow.

ianstormtaylor/slate.summary: 完全可定制的富文本编辑器框架，基于 React，用数据模型与插件构建自定义编辑体验，仍处于 beta。
ianstormtaylor/slate.summary_en: A fully customizable rich-text editor framework on React, building custom editing experiences from a data model and plugins; still in beta.

nginx/nginx.summary: NGINX 开源仓库，高性能 Web 服务器、反向代理、负载均衡与内容缓存，全球使用最广泛的 Web 服务器之一。
nginx/nginx.summary_en: The official NGINX open-source repository, a high-performance web server, reverse proxy, load balancer, and content cache, among the most widely used web servers in the world.

dragonflydb/dragonfly.summary: 现代化的 Redis 与 Memcached 兼容替代品，多线程架构，单机吞吐更高、内存效率更好。
dragonflydb/dragonfly.summary_en: A modern Redis- and Memcached-compatible replacement with a multi-threaded architecture, offering higher single-node throughput and better memory efficiency.

ReactiveX/rxjs.summary: JavaScript 的响应式编程库，用 Observable 组合异步和基于事件的程序，是 Angular 的核心依赖。
ReactiveX/rxjs.summary_en: A reactive programming library for JavaScript that composes asynchronous and event-based programs with Observables, and a core dependency of Angular.

grafana/k6.summary: 面向开发者的现代压测工具，用 JavaScript 编写测试脚本、Go 实现引擎，可集成 CI 做性能回归。
grafana/k6.summary_en: A modern load-testing tool for developers, with tests scripted in JavaScript and an engine in Go, integrable into CI for performance regression checks.

AvaloniaUI/Avalonia.summary: .NET 跨平台 UI 框架，用 C# 与 XAML 开发桌面、嵌入式、移动和 WebAssembly 应用，自绘控件、样式系统灵活。
AvaloniaUI/Avalonia.summary_en: A cross-platform .NET UI framework for desktop, embedded, mobile, and WebAssembly apps in C# and XAML, with self-drawn controls and a flexible styling system.

iced-rs/iced.summary: 受 Elm 启发的 Rust 跨平台 GUI 库，强调简洁与类型安全，采用消息驱动的架构。
iced-rs/iced.summary_en: A cross-platform GUI library for Rust inspired by Elm, emphasizing simplicity and type safety with a message-driven architecture.

docsifyjs/docsify.summary: 文档站点生成器，运行时把 Markdown 渲染成网站，无需构建，适合快速搭建项目文档。
docsifyjs/docsify.summary_en: A documentation site generator that renders Markdown into a site at runtime with no build step, handy for quickly setting up project docs.

fabricjs/fabric.js.summary: 简单强大的 HTML5 Canvas 库，提供对象模型、交互与 SVG 互转，常用于图形编辑器和在线设计工具。
fabricjs/fabric.js.summary_en: A simple and powerful HTML5 Canvas library with an object model, interactivity, and SVG import and export, commonly used for graphics editors and online design tools.

parallax/jsPDF.summary: 在客户端用 JavaScript 生成 PDF 的库，可直接在浏览器中创建和下载文档。
parallax/jsPDF.summary_en: A library that generates PDFs on the client with JavaScript, creating and downloading documents directly in the browser.

OAI/OpenAPI-Specification.summary: OpenAPI 规范仓库，定义描述 REST API 的标准格式，是接口文档、代码生成与测试工具的通用基础。
OAI/OpenAPI-Specification.summary_en: The repository of the OpenAPI Specification, a standard format for describing REST APIs and a common foundation for docs, code generation, and testing tools.

ascoders/weekly.summary: 「前端精读」周刊，每周精读一篇前端好文，涵盖前沿技术、源码解读，也涉及部分后端与商业思考。
ascoders/weekly.summary_en: The Front-End Close Reading weekly, going deep on one front-end article per week covering new technologies and source-code analysis, with some back-end and business topics.

SortableJS/Sortable.summary: 可重新排序的拖拽列表库，兼容现代浏览器和触摸设备，不依赖 jQuery，并有 Vue、React 等封装。
SortableJS/Sortable.summary_en: A drag-and-drop reorderable list library for modern browsers and touch devices, with no jQuery dependency and wrappers for Vue, React, and more.

symfony/symfony.summary: PHP Web 与控制台应用框架，同时是一组可复用组件的集合，Laravel、Drupal 等项目大量使用其组件。
symfony/symfony.summary_en: A PHP framework for web and console applications and a set of reusable components, widely used by projects such as Laravel and Drupal.

vercel/turborepo.summary: 用 Rust 写的 JavaScript / TypeScript Monorepo 构建系统，支持增量构建、任务并行和本地与远程缓存。
vercel/turborepo.summary_en: A Rust-based build system for JavaScript and TypeScript monorepos with incremental builds, parallel tasks, and local and remote caching.

mqyqingfeng/Blog.summary: 冴羽的技术博客，系列文章包括 JavaScript 深入、专题、ES6 和 React，中文前端进阶资料。
mqyqingfeng/Blog.summary_en: Yayu's technical blog with article series on JavaScript in depth, JavaScript topics, ES6, and React; Chinese advanced front-end material.

abiosoft/colima.summary: 在 macOS 和 Linux 上以最少配置运行容器运行时（Docker、containerd）和 Kubernetes，可替代 Docker Desktop。
abiosoft/colima.summary_en: Runs container runtimes (Docker, containerd) and Kubernetes on macOS and Linux with minimal setup, usable as a Docker Desktop alternative.

transloadit/uppy.summary: 精致的模块化 JavaScript 文件上传器，支持拖拽、断点续传、多来源导入（网盘、摄像头）和多种后端。
transloadit/uppy.summary_en: A sleek, modular JavaScript file uploader with drag and drop, resumable uploads, and imports from many sources such as cloud drives and cameras, working with several back ends.

heroui-inc/heroui.summary: 现代 React 组件库（前身 NextUI），基于 Tailwind CSS 与 React Aria，视觉精致、可访问性好。
heroui-inc/heroui.summary_en: A modern React component library (formerly NextUI) built on Tailwind CSS and React Aria, with polished visuals and good accessibility.

GoogleChrome/lighthouse.summary: 自动化网页质量审计工具，检测性能、可访问性、SEO 与最佳实践并给出改进建议，集成于 Chrome DevTools。
GoogleChrome/lighthouse.summary_en: An automated web-quality auditing tool that checks performance, accessibility, SEO, and best practices with improvement suggestions, integrated into Chrome DevTools.

emilk/egui.summary: 纯 Rust 的即时模式（immediate mode）GUI 库，可同时运行在原生桌面和浏览器（WebAssembly）中。
emilk/egui.summary_en: A pure Rust immediate-mode GUI library that runs on both native desktop and the browser via WebAssembly.

blueimp/jQuery-File-Upload.summary: jQuery 文件上传组件，支持多文件选择、拖拽、进度条、校验、分块与断点续传，并带图片和音视频预览；仓库已归档。
blueimp/jQuery-File-Upload.summary_en: A jQuery file upload widget with multi-file selection, drag and drop, progress bars, validation, chunked and resumable uploads, and image, audio, and video previews; the repository is archived.

jobbole/awesome-python-cn.summary: awesome-python 的中文版，Python 资源大全，涵盖 Web 框架、爬虫、模板引擎、数据库等。
